# Viraj Domadia

> Frontend-heavy full-stack developer in Bengaluru, India. Software Engineer at Zapigo (https://zapigo.com). Open to full-time and freelance work, on-site in Bengaluru or remote.

## About

Viraj Domadia is a frontend-heavy full-stack developer based in Bengaluru, originally from Mumbai. He works with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, FastAPI, PostgreSQL and MongoDB. He is a Software Engineer at Zapigo, where he owns the web frontend and built Personal Invites end to end. In 2024 he moved from IT operations into full-stack development through self-directed upskilling, after roles at Venus Vacations and Accenture. He is completing an online MCA at Amity University (2025–2027) and is open to full-time and freelance work, on-site in Bengaluru or remote.

## Experience

- Software Engineer · Zapigo (2025-10 → present): Own the frontend of zapigo.com: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, TanStack Query, Zustand and React Aria, with Vitest + Playwright tests and Sentry monitoring. Built Personal Invites end to end — create and share a digital invitation in under 30 seconds — including its FastAPI + PostgreSQL backend.
- IT Executive · Venus Vacations Pvt. Ltd (2024-07 → 2025-11): Ran the company’s IT and hardware. Alongside that, built the company website with a custom booking engine end to end — React front, Node/Express API, MongoDB — taken through internal review, not deployed.
- Application Development Associate · Accenture (2022-12 → 2023-07): Backup and support engineer on an enterprise client account: monitored NetBackup jobs, handled incidents and restores, and worked to SLAs in a large operations team.
- MCA · Amity University (2025-07 → 2027-06): Online MCA, alongside full-time work. B.Sc. IT · Narsee Monjee College of Commerce and Economics, Mumbai University · 2019–2022 · 8.33 CGPA

## Projects

- **Tripsmith** (Travel + AI concierge; in build · landing page live): A travel-agency site where a chatbot plans a real itinerary from live packages and starts the booking — tool-calling agent, Razorpay checkout, admin for packages and bookings. Live: https://tripsmith.vercel.app · Source: https://github.com/virajdomadia/tripsmith
- **Frontrow** (Live seat-map ticketing; in build · landing page live): Movie and concert tickets on a live seat map: tap a seat and it is held for ten minutes and greys out for everyone else — Redis holds, transactions, idempotent payments, QR tickets. Live: https://frontrow-viraj.vercel.app · Source: https://github.com/virajdomadia/frontrow
- **Pagecraft** (Co-edited website builder; in build · landing page live): A landing-page editor two people use at the same time — live cursors, conflict-free merges, version history — then one click publishes it to its own subdomain. Live: https://pagecraft-viraj.vercel.app · Source: https://github.com/virajdomadia/pagecraft
- **Offcut** (D2C store + visual search; in build · landing page live): A complete streetwear store — variants, inventory that cannot go negative, cart, orders, returns, admin — plus “drop a photo, shop the look” search on image embeddings. Live: https://offcut-viraj.vercel.app · Source: https://github.com/virajdomadia/offcut
- **Skillroom** (Video course platform; in build · landing page live): Creators upload video courses; students buy or subscribe, resume where they left off, pass quizzes and earn a certificate — streaming, recurring billing, payouts, three-role access. Live: https://skillroom-viraj.vercel.app · Source: https://github.com/virajdomadia/skillroom
- **Platter** (Food delivery + live tracking; in build · landing page live): Customer, restaurant and rider apps on one order state machine — restaurants within a radius, live rider location on the customer’s map, role-checked transitions. Live: https://platter-viraj.vercel.app · Source: https://github.com/virajdomadia/platter

Each one ships with a public repo, a live URL and a case study as it gets built. The landing pages are live now; the products follow.
